catalog.description: Shipped reference records of entity digest.tip.

values.name: Tip: No need to print, put in an envelop and post your invoices

tip_description.document:
Tip: No need to print, put in an envelop and post your invoices

Use the “Send by Post” option to post invoices automatically. For the cost of a local stamp, we do all the manual work: your invoice will be printed in the right country, put in an envelop and sent by snail mail. Use this feature from the list view to post hundreds of invoices in bulk.

values.name: Tip: Stop chasing the Documents you need

tip_description.document:
Tip: Stop chasing the Documents you need

Missing a document for a banking statement? Use the Documents apps to request it and let the owner upload it at the right place.

values.name: Tip: Automate everything with Automation Rules

tip_description.document:
Tip: Automate everything with Automation Rules

Send an email when an object changes state, archive records after a month of inactivity or remind yourself to follow-up on tasks when a specific tag is added.
With Automation Rules, you can automate any workflow.

values.name: Tip: Convert incoming emails into opportunities

tip_description.document:
Tip: Convert incoming emails into opportunities

Did you know emails sent to generate opportunities in your pipeline?
Try sending an email to your CRM. This email address is configurable by sales team members.

Did you know emails sent to a Sales Team alias generate opportunities in your pipeline?

values.name: Tip: Did you know the system has built-in lead mining?

tip_description.document:
Tip: Did you know the system has built-in lead mining?

For a sales team, there is nothing worse than being dry on leads. Fortunately, in just a few clicks, you can generate leads specifically targeted to your needs: company size, industry, etc. To help you test the feature, we offer you 20 credits for free.

values.name: Tip: Opportunity win rate is predicted with AI

tip_description.document:
Tip: Opportunity win rate is predicted with AI

the system's artificial intelligence engine predicts the success rate of each opportunity based on your history. You can always update the success rate manually, but if you let the system do the job the score is updated while the opportunity moves forward in your sales cycle.

values.name: Tip: Manage your pipeline

tip_description.document:
Tip: Manage your pipeline

A great tip to boost sales efficiency is to always define a next step on each opportunity. To manage ongoing activities, click on any status of the progress bar to filter opportunities based on their next activities' status. Click on the grey area of the progress bar to see all opportunities that have no next activity.

values.name: Tip: Do not waste time recording customers' data

tip_description.document:
Tip: Do not waste time recording customers' data

Did you know you can search a company by name or VAT number to instantly fill in all its data? The system autocompletes everything for you: logo, address, company size, business information, social media accounts, etc.

values.name: Tip: Turn a selection of opportunities into a map

tip_description.document:
Tip: Turn a selection of opportunities into a map

Did you know you can turn a list of opportunities into a map view, using the top-right map icon? A lot of screens in the system can be turned into a map: tasks, contacts, delivery orders, etc.

values.name: Tip: Identify Bottlenecks at a glance

tip_description.document:
Tip: Identify Bottlenecks at a glance

Check the Stage Tracker of Leads to identify bottlenecks in your Sales process.

values.name: Tip: Turn Sales Forecasting into Child's Play

tip_description.document:
Tip: Turn Sales Forecasting into Child's Play

Use the CRM Forecast Kanban to easily define when Opportunities are expected to be won.

values.name: Tip: Speed up your workflow with shortcuts

tip_description.document:
Tip: Speed up your workflow with shortcuts

Press ALT in any screen to highlight shortcuts for every button in the screen. It is useful to process multiple documents in batch.

values.name: Tip: Click on an avatar to chat with a user

tip_description.document:
Tip: Click on an avatar to chat with a user

Have a question about a document? Click on the responsible user's picture to start a conversation. If his avatar has a green dot, he is online.

values.name: Tip: A calculator in the system

tip_description.document:
Tip: A calculator in the system

When editing a number, you can use formulae by typing the `=` character. This is useful when computing a margin or a discount on a quotation, sale order or invoice.

values.name: Tip: How to ping users in internal notes?

tip_description.document:
Tip: How to ping users in internal notes?

Type "@" to notify someone in a message, or "#" to link to a channel. Try to notify @the system bot to test the feature.

values.name: Tip: Knowledge is power

tip_description.document:
Tip: Knowledge is power

When following documents, use the pencil icon to fine-tune the information you want to receive. Follow a project / sales team to keep track of this project's tasks / this team's opportunities.

values.name: Tip: Join the Dark Side

tip_description.document:
Tip: Join the Dark Side

Feeling eye strain? Give your eyes a break by switching to Dark Mode.

values.name: Tip: Personalize your Home Menu

tip_description.document:
Tip: Personalize your Home Menu

Click and hold on a Menu Item to reorder your Apps to your liking.

values.name: Tip: Where's Bryan?

tip_description.document:
Tip: Where's Bryan?

Activate Remote Work to let Employees specify where they are working from.

values.name: Tip: Snap pictures of your receipts with the remote app

tip_description.document:
Tip: Snap pictures of your receipts with the remote app

Do not keep your expense tickets in your pockets any longer. Just snap a picture of your receipt and let the system digitalizes it for you. The OCR and Artificial Intelligence will fill the data automatically.

values.name: Tip: Let candidates apply by email

tip_description.document:
Tip: Let candidates apply by email

By setting an alias to a job position, emails sent to this address create applications automatically. You can even use multiple trackers to get statistics according to the source of the application: LinkedIn, Monster, Indeed, etc. Try sending an email

values.name: Tip: Record your Timesheets faster

tip_description.document:
Tip: Record your Timesheets faster

Record your timesheets in an instant by pressing Shift + the corresponding hotkey to add 15min to your projects.

values.name: Tip: Use canned responses to chat faster

tip_description.document:
Tip: Use canned responses to chat faster

Use canned responses to define templates of messages in the livechat app. To load a canned response, start your sentence with '::' and select the template.

values.name: Tip: Use tablets in the shop to control manufacturing

tip_description.document:
Tip: Use tablets in the shop to control manufacturing

With the system work center control panel, your worker can start work orders in the shop and follow instructions of the worksheet. Quality tests are perfectly integrated into the process. Workers can trigger feedback loops, maintenance alerts, scrap products, etc.

values.name: Tip: Use task states to keep track of your tasks' progression

tip_description.document:
Tip: Use task states to keep track of your tasks' progression

Quickly check the status of tasks for approvals or change requests and identify those on hold until dependencies are resolved with the hourglass icon.

values.name: Tip: Create tasks from incoming emails

tip_description.document:
Tip: Create tasks from incoming emails

Emails sent to will generate tasks in your project.

Create tasks by sending an email to the email address of your project.

values.name: Tip: Your Own Personal Kanban

tip_description.document:
Tip: Your Own Personal Kanban

Use personal stages to organize your tasks and create your own workflow.

values.name: Tip: Project-Specific Fields

tip_description.document:
Tip: Project-Specific Fields

Add project-specific property fields on tasks to customize your project management process.

values.name: Tip: How to keep late receipts under control?

tip_description.document:
Tip: How to keep late receipts under control?

When creating a purchase order, have a look at the vendor's On Time Delivery rate: the percentage of products shipped on time. If it is too low, activate the automated reminders. A few days before the due shipment, the system will send the vendor an email to ask confirmation of shipment dates and keep you informed in case of any delays. To get the vendor's performance statistics, click on the OTD rate.

values.name: Tip: Never miss a purchase order

tip_description.document:
Tip: Never miss a purchase order

When sending a purchase order by email, the system asks the vendor to acknowledge the reception of the order. When the vendor acknowledges the order by clicking on a button in the email, the information is added on the purchase order. Use filters to track orders that have not been acknowledged.

values.name: Tip: the system supports configurable products

tip_description.document:
Tip: the system supports configurable products

Struggling with a complex product catalog? Try out the Product Configurator to help sales configure a product with different options: colors, size, capacity, etc. Make sale orders encoding easier and error-proof.

values.name: Tip: Sell or buy products in bulk with matrixes

tip_description.document:
Tip: Sell or buy products in bulk with matrixes

Selling the same product in different sizes or colors? Try the product grid and populate your orders with multiple quantities of each variant. This feature also exists in the Purchase application.

values.name: Tip: Speed up inventory operations with barcodes

tip_description.document:
Tip: Speed up inventory operations with barcodes

Enjoy a quick-paced experience with the system barcode app. It is blazing fast and works even without a stable internet connection. It supports all flows: inventory adjustments, batch picking, moving lots or pallets, low inventory checks, etc. Go to the "Apps" menu to activate the barcode interface.

values.name: Tip: Monitor Lot details

tip_description.document:
Tip: Monitor Lot details

Store and retrieve information regarding every Lot/Serial Number (condition, product info, ...).

values.name: Tip: Engage with visitors to convert them into leads

tip_description.document:
Tip: Engage with visitors to convert them into leads

Monitor your visitors while they are browsing your website with the system Social app. Engage with them in just a click using a live chat request or a push notification. If they have completed one of your forms, you can send them an SMS, or call them right away while they are browsing your website.

values.name: Tip: Use royalty-free photos

tip_description.document:
Tip: Use royalty-free photos

Search in the media dialogue when you need photos to illustrate your website. The system's integration with Unsplash, featuring millions of royalty free and high quality photos, makes it possible for you to get the perfect picture, in just a few clicks.

values.name: Tip: Search Engine Optimization (SEO)

tip_description.document:
Tip: Search Engine Optimization (SEO)

To get more visitors, you should target keywords that are often searched in Google. With the built-in SEO tool, once you define a few keywords, the system will recommend you the best keywords to target. Then adapt your title and description accordingly to boost your traffic.

values.name: Tip: Use illustrations to spice up your website

tip_description.document:
Tip: Use illustrations to spice up your website

Not only can you search for royalty-free illustrations, their colors are also converted so that they always fit your Theme.

values.name: Tip: Add shapes to energize your Website

tip_description.document:
Tip: Add shapes to energize your Website

More than 90 shapes exist and their colors are picked to match your Theme.
